title: Compliance Harm Observations
summary: A browser-only tool for WA NFPs to document frontline compliance harm observations, score them against policy objectives, and generate plain-language advocacy evidence snapshots.

commons.artifact_content: Browser-only compliance harm observation tool for WA NFPs. Scores observations against dignity, wellbeing, housing stability, employment pathway dimensions. Generates advocacy evidence snapshots.

safety.review_notes: FL-008A assisted Factory promotion. Static HTML inspected locally. No network/storage/secret findings. Browser-only data.
